claims.text: The equimolar WTaTiVZr HEA has enhanced plastic strain and toughness relative to pure tungsten under high-temperature mechanical loading.
High lattice distortion is the primary cause of the HEA's enhanced plastic strain and toughness.
Lattice distortion creates a complex local atomic environment in WTaTiVZr.
The complex local atomic environment impedes rapid dislocation motion.
The complex local atomic environment impedes crack propagation.
Impeded dislocation motion and crack propagation promote distributed plastic deformation and delay catastrophic brittle fracture.
The proposed processing can produce WTaTiVZr and pure-tungsten specimens with similar coarse-grained, recrystallized microstructures.
Arc melting followed by homogenization ensures an equimolar distribution of W, Ta, Ti, V, and Zr.
Matching the coarse-grained microstructures minimizes differences between the specimens aside from composition.
Atomic-scale lattice distortion produces a heterogeneous energy landscape that modulates dislocation interactions.
Multiple principal elements create local variations in bonding and activation energies for dislocation motion.
These local variations enhance dislocation cross-slip and multiplication in WTaTiVZr.
Lattice-distortion-mediated dislocation interactions distribute stress more evenly at crack tips.
Brittle fracture pathways dominate over ductile deformation mechanisms in pure tungsten under the stated loading conditions.
At 800–1200°C and strain rates of 10^-4 to 10^-3 s^-1, WTaTiVZr will exhibit greater plastic strain than pure tungsten.
Under the stated conditions, WTaTiVZr will exhibit greater toughness and delayed crack propagation relative to pure tungsten.
Post-test microscopy will show a higher density of mobile dislocations in WTaTiVZr than in pure tungsten.
Post-test microscopy will show more complex dislocation interactions in WTaTiVZr than in pure tungsten.
The hypothesized behavioral distinction applies approximately from 800°C to 1200°C when the materials have comparable grain structures.
